title: Marianna’s Chili

items: 4.5 pounds beef (chili ground or cubed chuck)
2 (28 ounce) cans fire roasted tomatoes, diced with juice
2 adobo chili peppers, minced or pureed

3 (15 ounce) cans of beans (red, pinto, black)For dry beans:1.5 cups dry beans, soaked overnight in waterrinse beans, 2 whole cloves of garlic and half a large onion, then pressure cook for 25 minutes and natural release.  Remove garlic and onion, add 1 Tbsp salt, and simmer 20 minutes longer (slow cooker mode).

steps: Brown the beef in a large pot over high heat.  Drain any excessive grease and return to pot.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Simmer over low heat for 45 minutes.
Remove from heat and serve.  For the best flavor make it the day before and refrigerate overnight to let the flavors meld, then reheat and serve the following day.
Serving suggestions:  corn-bread, Fritos, shredded cheddar, fresh diced onions, cilantro, and/or sour cream.
